justification: Fixes a confirmed silent-wrong-result defect (issue #751): the premium pre-DA pipeline serves a 130s HTTP-200 report with every timeline year no_data when Tessera tile coverage is absent at the location — a hollow paid artifact that would be a refund case. Registry-verified live for 20 Patanga St Kincumber (only 2024 published, zero consecutive pairs). Critical because the failure is invisible to the buyer at purchase time.

pre_impl.existing_data: No stored rows change shape; refused runs write NO pre_da_history_reports row in the direct flow and mark the pre-allocated async row status='error' via the existing _mark_error path — no new status value, no migration.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Callers that treated every 200 as a complete report now receive {refused: true, reason, reason_code} — the same contract flood_truth already uses, and the only current callers are the brief premium fetch (updated in this PR) and direct API use.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Applies to every future run; no persisted artifact needs backfill (hollow historical rows keep status='complete' but the product has no UI path yet).
pre_impl.external_source_error: A failure of the registry pre-flight itself is NOT treated as a coverage gap — the run proceeds and the all-no_data backstop still fails it closed; only confirmed no-coverage refuses early.
pre_impl.frontend_type: No frontend change: premium stays UI-dark; the async poll already renders status='error' as a failure, never as a complete report.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A buyer at an uncovered location now gets an immediate, reason-coded refusal instead of paying 130s of compute for a report whose every year reads 'Satellite data unavailable'.

functions.name: check_tessera_coverage
functions.input: a constructed GeoTessera client, the lot centroid lat/lon, and the ordered list of timeline years to probe
functions.output: set of years whose published registry has a tile intersecting the lot + neighbourhood sample bounds (registry manifest only, no tile downloads)
functions.if_none: an empty set means no year is covered — the caller refuses before the heavy run

functions.name: _consecutive_covered_pairs
functions.input: the set of registry-covered years plus the ordered YEARS list the timeline is computed over
functions.output: count of (N-1, N) pairs where both years are covered — the number of computable timeline points
functions.if_none: zero pairs (e.g. the live Kincumber case: only 2024 published) triggers the pre-flight refusal

functions.name: _build_refusal
functions.input: request, coordinates, council, reason code + prose, covered years
functions.output: flood_truth-style refused dict (refused=true, reason_code, reason, covered_years) after marking any pre-allocated async row errored
functions.if_none: report_id None makes _mark_error a no-op; the direct caller still gets the refused body

functions.name: _run_pre_da_history_inner
functions.input: the validated PreDAHistoryRequest carrying address, optional lot area, and optional pre-allocated report row id
functions.output: completed report dict, or a refused dict from the coverage pre-flight (before the ~130s run) or the all-no_data backstop (after annotation, before the DB write)
functions.if_none: a pre-flight exception logs and proceeds — refusal only on confirmed no-coverage or a confirmed empty timeline

functions.name: _pre_da_reason
functions.input: the raw pre-DA pipeline payload dict, a refused dict, or None when premium was not requested
functions.output: the refusal's own prose reason when refused, else the generic not-requested/failed string
functions.if_none: None or non-refused payloads keep the pre-change generic reason exactly

values.if_missing: None (check failed) skips the pre-flight refusal entirely; the backstop still guards the output

values.value: timeline entry level in the backstop gate
values.if_missing: annotate_timeline always emits a level for every year; any non-no_data entry lets the report complete
absent key reads falsy so successful payloads build the detail exactly as before

break_it.scenario: Location with a single published year (live Kincumber case) purchases a premium report
break_it.what_happens: Pre-change: 130s run, HTTP 200, all years 'Satellite data unavailable', report stored as complete
break_it.how: pre-flight counts zero consecutive covered pairs and refuses before any sampling; heavy sampler asserted-not-called in test

break_it.scenario: Registry says covered but tile downloads fail on the container — sampling yields NaN everywhere
break_it.what_happens: Pre-flight passes, so without a backstop the hollow report would still be served and stored
break_it.how: all-no_data timeline returns a refused dict before the DB write (DB access asserted-not-reached in test)

break_it.scenario: The registry manifest fetch itself errors (network) at a location that HAS coverage
break_it.what_happens: Naive fail-closed would refuse good locations whenever the registry hiccups
break_it.how: pre-flight exceptions log and proceed to sampling; only the output gate can refuse then

break_it.scenario: Sparse-but-viable coverage (one consecutive pair) gets over-blocked by the new gates
break_it.what_happens: Legitimate partial reports would be refused, shrinking the product's coverage area
break_it.how: MIN_CONSECUTIVE_COVERED_PAIRS=1 — one computable pair completes with the uncovered years honestly marked no_data

break_it.scenario: Async Trigger.dev flow: refusal leaves the pre-allocated row 'pending' and the frontend polls forever
break_it.what_happens: The poll would hang with no terminal state
break_it.how: _build_refusal calls _mark_error first — row goes status='error' with the refusal prose as error_msg

break_it.scenario: Brief premium section renders the refusal as a crash instead of a reason-coded legit-empty
break_it.what_happens: Users would see a generic failure with no explanation of the coverage gap
break_it.how: _build_pre_da_detail returns None on refused and _pre_da_reason threads the refusal prose onto the NOT_AVAILABLE DataField

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — POST /pipeline/pre-da-history for 20 PATANGA STREET KINCUMBER 2251 on deployed Railway: response arrives in seconds (not ~130s) with refused=true, reason_code=satellite_coverage_unavailable, covered_years=[2024]
